console.endEarlyHint: Hold to end the session. Counts as a loss.

pixelate.name: Pixelate
pixelate.description: Images are pixelated. Stacks with every new Pixelate card.

success_multiplier.name: Hail Mary
success_multiplier.description: Multiplies your chance on the final wheel.

splatter.name: Splatter
splatter.description: Some cards are covered with splatter.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Blocks the next bad action (not Mistress Says No).

showcase.title: Component showcase
showcase.dialogBody: Focus is trapped inside. Press Esc to close.
showcase.drawerBody: The gallery grid lands here in AP5.

clearing_edges.name: Clearing Edges
clearing_edges.description: Hold at the edge. Afterwards remove one negative effect of your choice.

good_fairy.name: Good Fairy
good_fairy.description: Remove one negative effect for free – or get a shield if you have none.

decision_maker.name: Decision Maker
decision_maker.description: You choose the number of your next move.

cleaning_lady.name: Cleaning Lady
cleaning_lady.description: All pixelation and splatter are washed away.

hail_mary.name: Hail Mary
hail_mary.description: Your chance on the final wheel gets multiplied.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.description: Swap the images of the undiscovered cards for another category.

squeeze_task.name: Squeeze
squeeze_task.description: Squeeze and release – count every one.

edge_and_hold.name: Edge & Hold
edge_and_hold.description: Take yourself right to the edge, then hands off. Hold until the timer hits zero.

double_trouble.name: Double Trouble
double_trouble.description: Every task counts double for a few rounds.

mistress_says_no.name: Mistress Says No
mistress_says_no.description: No. The session ends right here.

guessing_game.name: Guessing Game
guessing_game.description: Pick two numbers, then the die decides.

goal_teleport.name: Goal Teleport
goal_teleport.description: Finish the task – then the goal jumps somewhere else.

u_turn.name: U Turn
u_turn.description: No turning back: the direction you came from is blocked.

moving_day.name: Moving Day
moving_day.description: Finish the task – then you get moved to a random field.

highperformer.name: Highperformer
highperformer.description: As many as you can before the timer runs out.

take_it_slow.name: Take it Slow
take_it_slow.description: Slow and deep for a few rounds.

speed_it_up.name: Speed it Up
speed_it_up.description: Fast and hard for a few rounds.

library.title: Library
library.noFolders: Add a folder to get started.

status.missing: Folder not found – drive disconnected or moved?
status.tooFew: Only {{count}} of {{min}} required files – not used in sessions

detail.noMedia: No supported files in this folder (jpg, png, webp, gif, webm, mp4).

remove.title: Remove folder?
remove.body: "{{name}}" is removed from the library. Files on disk are not touched.

add.intro: Choose whether each folder holds good or bad images, and whether they are used for normal cards (content) or action cards.

empty.title: Add your folders
empty.body: Chance Runner plays with images from folders on this computer. Nothing leaves your machine.
empty.step1: Pick one or more folders – each folder is one category.
empty.step2: Mark each folder as good or bad, and as content or action images.
empty.step3: The library is scanned; you need at least one good and one bad content folder to play.

start.title: Spin for your goal
start.body: Your number is your goal field. Land on it exactly to reach the final wheel.
start.lockedBody: You hit a penalty field. The wheel unlocks in
start.notReadyBody: You need at least one enabled good and one enabled bad content folder with enough files.

generation.no_good_category: No usable good content folder. Check the library.
generation.no_bad_category: No usable bad content folder. Check the library.

resume.title: Resume session?
resume.body: A session was still running when the app closed.
resume.endEarlyHint: Ending early counts as a loss.

step.pickEffect: Pick a negative effect to remove

reward.title: You guessed right – choose a reward

step.switcherooPool: What do you want to swap?

effectApplied.u_turn: Your direction is blocked for {{rounds}} rounds
effectApplied.shield: Shield up – it blocks the next bad action

notice.guessMiss: Rolled {{roll}} – you guessed {{first}} and {{second}}. No match.
notice.goalMoved: The goal moved from field {{from}} to field {{to}}
notice.playerMoved: You moved from field {{from}} to field {{to}}

win.checkBody: You discovered {{discovered}} of 100 cards. Roll to set your chance: discovered ÷ roll.
win.wheelBody: Stay right at the edge. The wheel stops when the countdown hits zero. White: you may finish. Red: denied.

reward.block_bad_action: Block a random bad action next session

outcome.deniedBody: Not this time. Denied is neutral: no penalty fields, no changes to your chances.
